info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the Identity Federation Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032). Registers an organisation's OIDC provider (the client secret is only NAMED, never stored), edits it while DISABLED, enables and disables it, links an external identity to a user, revokes the link and re-links, and reads the provider audit ledger; negative cases cover validation (plain-http issuer, a secret reference that is not a variable name, scopes without openid), the provider and link lifecycle rules, one provider per organisation, an identity and a user each linked once while ACTIVE, tenant isolation, the absence of DELETE and the public sign-in routes refusing a disabled provider, an unknown organisation, an unknown state and a provider-side refusal, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. The sign-in itself needs a real OIDC provider and is proved by federation-smoke against a provider double. It registers under its own generated tenant id (federationOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: Identity Federation Service - Providers, Links and Sign-in Guards Suite
